message:
The other day, as we were packing our go-bags, we stumbled upon a forgotten stash of snacks we had tucked away for emergencies. 🍫 It felt like finding hidden treasure! We realized that having those little comforts on hand could really lift spirits during stressful times. It’s funny how a small win, like remembering to pack some favorite treats, can make all the difference when you’re trying to be prepared. 
We’d love to hear your tips! What’s a small win that’s made your family feel more ready?
